subject: microbiology
title: Staphylococcus aureus, MRSA and coagulase negative staphylococci

steps.tx: **Staphylococcus aureus** clusters like grapes as Gram positive cocci because division planes stay random, and the laboratory separates it from streptococci by **catalase positivity** (bubbles with hydrogen peroxide) and from coagulase negative species by **tube coagulase** (free coagulase clotting plasma). Golden pigment, beta haemolysis on blood agar and mannitol fermentation support the call, while protein A (binding Fc of IgG) explains phagocytosis evasion. Slide coagulase detects bound clumping factor rapidly.
steps.say: Grape like clusters that bubble with peroxide and clot plasma are aureus. Catalase splits staph from strep.

steps.tx: **Toxin diseases** declare themselves fast: **staphylococcal food poisoning** (preformed heat stable enterotoxin in cream filled sweets, vomiting within 6 hours, no fever, self limiting with fluids), **toxic shock syndrome** (TSST-1 superantigen in tampon users or wound packing, fever with rash, desquamation and hypotension), and **staphylococcal scalded skin syndrome** (exfoliatin in neonates, Nikolsky positive but mucosa spared, unlike TEN). PVL strains necrotise lungs after viral illness.
steps.say: Vomiting 6 hours after sweets is preformed toxin. Scalded neonate with spared mucosa is exfoliatin.

steps.tx: **MRSA** carries **mecA** on SCCmec encoding PBP2a, a transpeptidase with a closed active site that beta lactams cannot reach, so oxacillin screening flags resistance to the whole class except ceftaroline. Hospital clones (SCCmec I to III, multidrug resistant) differ from community clones (SCCmec IV, PVL positive skin abscesses). **Vancomycin** remains the parenteral backbone with trough and MIC creep watched; **VRSA** (vanA from enterococci) needs linezolid or daptomycin (never in pneumonia, surfactant inactivates). Mupirocin decolonises carriers with contact precautions containing spread.
steps.say: Oxacillin resistant means whole beta lactam class fails. Community MRSA abscesses carry PVL.

steps.tx: **Coagulase negative staphylococci** matter on hardware: **S. epidermidis** (biofilm slime on catheters, shunts and prosthetic valves, novobiocin sensitive) causes indolent device infections needing removal, while **S. saprophyticus** (novobiocin resistant) causes honeymoon cystitis in young women. **S. lugdunensis**, though coagulase negative, behaves like aureus with aggressive native valve endocarditis and needs full aureus style therapy. Speciation guides whether to pull the line or treat the bladder.
steps.say: Device infection with slime is epidermidis: pull hardware. Honeymoon cystitis resisting novobiocin is saprophyticus.
